description: Deterministic work bounds of zone interest and tick operations (#138) and of Greyhaven client presentation (#645); counters come from mmorpg-core and mmorpg-presentation, never wall-clock time.

scenarios.description: Camera-only frames orbiting a standing viewer at the Greyhaven hub
One viewer with a fixed local neighbourhood in a zone of 512 players

operations.description: Project one viewer's visible snapshot: candidate work follows its local neighbourhood, not the zone population.

local.description: players inside the viewer's interest neighbourhood

metrics.name: entity_records_built
metrics.notes: Built after the radius test and the priority cap (#1056), so at most the visible records.

metrics.name: sheets_built
metrics.notes: Bag, quest, world and waystone sheets built in a warm publication to an unchanged viewer (#1056).

operations.description: Publish every player's snapshot in a sparse zone: total candidate work is linear in recipients at a fixed local density.

recipients.description: players receiving a snapshot, spread at a fixed density

metrics.name: entity_records_built
metrics.notes: Built after the radius test (#1056): the relevant units, never every candidate.

metrics.name: zone_views_built
metrics.notes: Doors, pieces and spent veins, built once per tick for every recipient (#1056).

metrics.name: sheets_built
metrics.notes: Bag, quest, world and waystone sheets built in a warm publication to unchanged viewers (#1056).

operations.description: Publish every player's snapshot when everyone stands in one hub: each recipient's candidates grow with the crowd, honestly quadratic in total.

recipients.description: players crowded within one interest radius

metrics.name: largest_recipient_records
metrics.notes: Entity records the largest recipient's projection built (#1056): the priority cap, never the crowd.

metrics.name: zone_views_built
metrics.notes: Doors, pieces and spent veins, built once per tick for every recipient (#1056).

metrics.name: sheets_built
metrics.notes: Bag, quest, world and waystone sheets built in a warm publication to unchanged viewers (#1056).

operations.description: Advance one tick: interest index writes follow the units that change cells, never a rebuild, whatever the stationary population.

moved.description: players crossing an interest cell boundary this tick

metrics.name: units_inspected
metrics.notes: Maintenance re-reads every body position once per tick; it must stay linear, not rebuild.

operations.description: Advance one warm tick (#1086): the creature systems visit only active creatures (engaged, casting, holding a timer or awake), an idle population asleep beyond every player's wake radius costs nothing, the tick's interest queries reuse warm buffers and its heap allocations do not grow with the sleepers. Measured by mmorpg-core's creature_tick_work example and test.

idle.description: aggressive wolves asleep far from the only player

metrics.name: creatures_visited
metrics.notes: Visits by decisions, swings, casts, auras and corpse timers in the largest measured tick; a fighter is visited by each at most once. Before #1086 every system visited every creature (5 × (idle + active)).

metrics.name: interest_query_allocations
metrics.notes: Interest query results that outgrew their buffer in the largest measured tick (the wake sweep, pace, aggro and assist queries reuse the zone's buffers).

metrics.name: warm_tick_allocations
metrics.notes: Counting allocator around advance_tick, the largest measured tick; 282, 617 and 1,265 at 64, 128 and 256 sleepers before #1086.

operations.description: One indexed named-area lookup (#1063): discovery and explore objectives run it for every player every tick, and its polygon edge tests stay under a fixed bound however densely Greyhaven's traced areas are sampled.

samples.description: lookups on an even grid over the playable bounds

metrics.name: largest_lookup_edge_tests
metrics.notes: ZoneAreas::lookup_work_bound is the exact worst case over the index; core's Greyhaven tests hold it under the same budget.

operations.description: Greyhaven client presentation (#645): camera-only frames around a standing viewer over settled static residency build, upload and evict no static scenery, whatever the authored scenery.

frames.description: measured frames after residency settles and one warm-up lap

orbit_metres.description: camera orbit radius around the viewer, metres

metrics.name: static_builds
metrics.notes: Static groups and near terrain tiles built (the complete static world is 4,169 groups and 96 tiles).

metrics.name: largest_frame_draws
metrics.notes: Static draw records one frame selects before renderer batching; nothing is hidden to shrink it.

operations.description: Greyhaven client presentation (#645): walking east from the hub enters and leaves terrain tiles and group reaches; streaming builds stay within the per-frame budget.

metres.description: metres walked at a running pace (0.1 m per frame)

metrics.name: largest_frame_builds
metrics.notes: tiles::BUILDS_PER_FRAME (2) plus GROUP_BUILDS_PER_FRAME (8).

operations.description: Greyhaven client presentation (#645): one frame of the shared unit presenter over a wolf crowd with one moving wolf; draws follow the animated characters, geometry uploads do not.

characters.description: wolves added around the viewer (animated characters A)

metrics.name: geometry_uploads
metrics.notes: New unit geometries over 64 frames after a warm-up frame; breathing animal torsos still add one per family and frame (advisory).

metrics.name: layout_entity_lookups
metrics.notes: The browser layout (#1057, mmorpg-wasm unit_layout): one indexed snapshot record per sampled unit and one view per imported unit; a linear find per unit fails it.

metrics.name: layout_bytes
metrics.notes: Typed-array words, numbers, model matrices and newly interned strings of the last frame; no JSON.

metrics.name: warm_frame_allocations
metrics.notes: Counting allocator around the adapter's sampling and layout of one warm frame (the shared presenter's own frame excluded); only the breathing torsos' new keys intern a string.

operations.description: Snapshot interpolation both clients draw units with (#1058, mmorpg-client-model's SnapshotHistory, measured through the browser's mmorpg-wasm adapter): one frame sampled 2 ticks behind the newest projection walks the two bracketing projections once.

metrics.name: samples_visited
metrics.notes: Entity records of the two bracketing projections visited by one frame's sample (a merge walk over orders indexed once per push); a find per unit fails it.

metrics.name: warm_frame_allocations
metrics.notes: Counting allocator around one warm frame's interpolation, the sampled records included; the history and poses reuse their buffers.

operations.description: Browser projection ingest (#1009): a running Greyhaven player's projections, local and online, each decoded once into the session's WASM projection store, read by the unit presenter by id; sheets reach the page only when they change.

ticks.description: projections ingested per path (local and online)

metrics.name: largest_decodes_per_projection
metrics.notes: From receipt to the unit presenter and its sound cues.

metrics.name: unchanged_sheet_views
metrics.notes: Bag and quest sheet objects materialised for the page although equal to the copy it holds.

metrics.name: extra_boundary_bytes
metrics.notes: Projection bytes copied into WASM beyond the online network payload; a local projection never crosses.

operations.description: Browser world frame (#1060): WorldView.frame() runs ordered presenter stages over one reused context; a warm frame with nothing changed redraws no panel and rebuilds no render-root list. Measured by web/tests/frame-stages.test.ts (bun test).

frames.description: warm frames after a first frame that received a projection and drew every root

metrics.name: largest_frame_stage_calls
metrics.notes: Presenter stage calls of one frame: input, replication, units, camera, scenery, render, hud and panels (WORLD_FRAME_STAGES).

metrics.name: panel_renders
metrics.notes: Panel updates over the warm frames; panels redraw only for a received projection, a changed latest projection or a changed bag revision.

metrics.name: root_rebuilds
metrics.notes: Render-root list rebuilds over the warm frames; the registry rebuilds only when a root owner's revision moves or the view marks it dirty.

metrics.name: action_bar_decodes
metrics.notes: Action-bar projection decodes (#1091) over warm hud frames showing one projection: the class HUD hands the module each projection once (ActionBarCache).

operations.description: Browser scenery frame (#1091): SceneryFrame.nodes() selects each resident instance batch's kept shown or hidden renderer batch; a warm frame copies none of the world's instance batches. Measured by web/tests/scene-building.test.ts (bun test).

frames.description: warm frames from one eye after a first frame that drew every resident batch

metrics.name: instance_batch_views_built
metrics.notes: Instance-batch views built over the warm frames; each batch builds at most one shown and one hidden view in its lifetime (5,699 batches in Greyhaven, which every frame used to copy).

operations.description: Browser sun shadows (#1083): a camera walking and turning through Greyhaven redraws at most two of the three sun cascades a frame (the far two take turns, three-lighting cascadeUpdateIntervals), and a skinned unit's shadow proxy draws a simplified share of its body's triangles in each cascade. Measured by web/tests/shadow-lod.test.ts (bun test), without a GPU.

frames.description: frames of a fixed camera walk (6 m/s, a quarter turn every four seconds) after the first

metrics.name: largest_frame_cascade_redraws
metrics.notes: Sun cascades one frame redraws (StaggeredCascades with CASCADE_UPDATE_INTERVALS [1, 2, 2]); a kept cascade the view leaves is redrawn early.

metrics.name: unit_near_shadow_triangle_percent
metrics.notes: Triangles the nearest cascade draws for an 18 624-triangle skinned capsule's shadow proxy, of the body's (30 % at #1083).

metrics.name: unit_far_shadow_triangle_percent
metrics.notes: The same in the middle and far cascades (10 % at #1083).

operations.description: Browser world build (#855): a page whose zone content is seeded, from its world-build worker or the release-keyed derived cache, rebuilds none of the content's costly base parts (terrain heights, colliders, solid dressing) while it builds the content, catalog, presentation scenery and local zone it enters.

seeds.description: content seeds a fresh page applies

metrics.name: base_part_builds
metrics.notes: Seeded base parts the page built again; an unseeded page builds all three.
